correctness.rationale: A complemented Schur, non-RNP range Y gives a projection P that is Dunford–Pettis; if P factored through l1 then P|Y=id would embed Y as a closed subspace of l1, forcing RNP, contradiction. Idempotence gives P=P^n in every closed power. The representable-ideal inclusion follows from a complemented l1 factorization, and Nasseri supplies I_2 proper in D. The quotient therefore contains a nonzero idempotent in every power.
